# Trunk-Based Development Practice

> Operational guidance for engineering teams adopting trunk-based development, with a Salesforce focus.

Site: https://corekraft.github.io/trunk-based-development-docs/

## Preferred entry points

- Overview: https://corekraft.github.io/trunk-based-development-docs/docs/
- Core Principles: https://corekraft.github.io/trunk-based-development-docs/docs/foundations/core-principles
- Why Salesforce Needs TBD: https://corekraft.github.io/trunk-based-development-docs/docs/salesforce/why-salesforce-needs-tbd
- Starting Steps: https://corekraft.github.io/trunk-based-development-docs/docs/salesforce/starting-steps

## Scope

This site explains trunk-based development practices, migration guidance, continuous integration expectations, and Salesforce-specific implementation advice.
